name: Turn new blog posts into social post drafts with OpenAI and approve them in Socialync

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow watches a blog or RSS feed. For each new article, an AI model writes a short caption from the title and summary, and the workflow adds the article link. Socialync holds the post as a draft with a planned time. Nothing is scheduled or published until you approve the draft on the MCP Draft Approvals page in Socialync. Approve it before the planned time. A draft nobody approves expires after 24 hours.

Content written by an AI model must be approved by a person before it is scheduled or published, so this workflow has no approve step. Do not add one.

The article address is the idempotency key, so a repeated call within 24 hours does not create a second draft.

### Setup
1. Create an API key at https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node-keys and add it as a Socialync credential.
2. Add an OpenAI credential, or swap in any chat model.
3. Replace the feed address in the trigger node.
4. In Settings, choose the platforms and the caption style. Connect those platforms in Socialync first.
5. To test, use a feed that has a recent article and run the workflow once. Then approve or reject the draft in Socialync.

### Customization
Change the delay before the planned time, the longest post and the caption style in Settings. The delay is the time you have to approve, up to 24 hours. Text and link posts only. Add an image by switching the Media field of the Socialync node to Image URLs.

API reference: https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node

parameters.content:
## Read the feed
Each new article starts one run. Settings holds your choices.

## Write the post
An AI model writes the caption. The code adds the link and checks the length.

## Hold it for approval
Socialync holds the post as a draft. Approve it in Socialync before the planned time. A refused draft shows its reason in the last node.

## Feed address
Replace the feed address in the trigger before you run anything.
